paper.title_en: Diameter Growth of $\mathrm{U}(2^N)$ under Cliff Metrics
paper.abstract_en: Cliff metrics are right invariant Riemannian metrics on the unitary group $\mathrm{U}(2^N)$ introduced by Nielsen and his collaborators in the geometric approach for gate complexity in quantum computations. In this paper, we compute the exponential growth rate for the diameter of $\mathrm{U}(2^N)$ equipped with cliff metrics as $N \rightarrow \infty$. We prove that if the norm of most generalized Pauli matrices are sufficiently large, this growth rate coincides with the growth rate of maximal gate complexity obtained by Knill.
